problems.what: The fully wrapped head with an eye band and a smooth bare face reads as a mummy or blank mannequin at portrait and chip size (ruling 30 class). Painting cannot fix it because the gate holds the paint on-model.
problems.fix: Units lane: break up the wraps (a cloth hood or scarf over hair or skin, a visible brow and eyes under or beside the band), then re-render the cards.

problems.what: Plain face plate with a single slit and a striated neck: a blank mannequin read. The rishal commit already leaves it open.
problems.fix: Units lane: give the plate a brow, lids or eye glazing (no glow) and soften the neck striation, then re-render.

problems.what: Hollow near-black eye holes in a cracked pale mask (a horror or hockey-mask lean), against odrum.md's 'never black holes'.
problems.fix: Lift the recess glaze to the documented umber #5A4130 with a lit lower wall or a pupil or lid mark, as ruling 2 did for Shadeprint, then re-render.

problems.what: The arrow shaft runs over the centre of the face (an arrow-through-head read), and the aiming hand is a stump.
problems.fix: Restage: turn the head or move the camera so the quiver arrows clear the face, and use a frame with an open hand.

problems.what: The paint aged and cracked the face (pinhole pupils, under-eye shading, nostril hollows). First Bell also has invented hem dots.
problems.fix: Ship the 3D finish for these two, or repaint with a 'smooth carved face, no cracks' line and add a crack and texture check to the pre-gate.

problems.what: The pose hides the face: a back view, a blade across the mask, a back view.
problems.fix: Restage to a frame where the face reads, as was done on the busts.

problems.what: Hard-edged quad with a white stripe on the ground between the feet.
problems.fix: Find it in the plate or catcher (plates.py) and paint it out or move the plate.

problems.what: The compose grade either washes the figure milky (Gorgewalk, Ulkro) or oversaturates it (Odrum Shadeprint violet). Gorgewalk also loses the bowstring.
problems.fix: Hold the figure grade to the render's value and chroma within a dE limit inside the figure mask, and keep thin parts (strings) above a minimum contrast.

problems.what: Claw-like raised hand (Nurrow), pale sole outlines with no contact shadow (Stillwater), crumpled foot (Lamplit).
problems.fix: Card-hand pass on Nurrow's raised hand; seat the soles and restore the catcher shadow; restage Lamplit.

problems.what: The slit's stitch ticks read as teeth (portrait), and one dark dot reads as a single eye (Long Evening).
problems.fix: Ship painted v2 for the portrait once the highlight gate is resolved, or lift the ticks; render the Long Evening slit with two lidded eyes.
